desc:
Welcome to the final letters of the challenge arena, where words are your only weapon. Do you have the speed and intelligence to survive? The rule is simple: The word begins with the last letter your opponent ended with. Be ready or leave the arena! 💥

⚠️ Note: The game is still in the experimental phase. You may encounter some bugs, and we promise major improvements and changes soon. 

🎁 Join the group to receive prizes and activate codes! Your support means a lot to us! Don't forget to like the game and add it to your favorites to receive updates firsthand. ⭐️👍 Created with pride by Saudi hands - inspired and developed, 

This game is inspired by the original "Last Letter" game created by @mmii665 (MmiiGames).

Special thanks to 52 (@pdjdish56) for recommending this Idea.
